content:
sam: Heads-up — helm upgrade of `inference-serving` -> v3.2.0 stalled in canary. Pre-upgrade hook job `migrate-cache` is Pending and blocking the release.

sam: `kubectl describe pod` shows Unschedulable: "0/10 nodes are available: 10 Insufficient gpu.redwood.com/card"

maria: Wait, the migrate job should not require GPUs. Why is it requesting them?

sam: Chart still has `resources.requests: { "nvidia.com/gpu": 1 }` in the `migrator` container. Cluster device-plugin was updated earlier and we migrated resource name to `gpu.redwood.com/card`.

lee: Also FYI: terraform renamed nodepool label keys today (nodepool=ai-32 -> nodepool=inference-32). The job has an old nodeSelector `nodepool: ai-32` so it's unschedulable even if GPU resource matches.

anika: I'm on it. quick attempt: patch job to remove nodeSelector and GPU request so it can run on any node.

sam: I tried: `kubectl patch job migrate-cache -p '{"spec": {"template":{"spec":{"nodeSelector": null, "containers":[{"name":"migrator","resources":{}}]}}}}'` but helm hook ownership prevents the upgrade from progressing — helm waits for hook completion.

infra-bot: helm upgrade aborted: pre-upgrade-hook job `migrate-cache` failed to complete within configured timeout (1h).

dave: The hook created a `CacheMigration` CR instance `cache-2024` and it has a finalizer `migration.redwood.com/lock`. Helm rollback can't delete the CR while the finalizer is present — so resources are stuck.

anika: Confirmed. We should ensure the migration isn't half-complete before forcing cleanup. sam — any migration logs?

sam: Checked Redis and migration target stats — no keys moved, job never started the binary. Safe to force remove finalizer.

anika: Patching CR: `kubectl patch cachemigration cache-2024 -p '{"metadata":{"finalizers":[]}}' --type=merge` then deleting the hook job. Doing it now.

maria: careful but :+1: if it's safe.

anika: Done — finalizer removed, CR deleted, job cleared. Re-running helm upgrade with `--set migrate.enable=false` to skip the migration hook for this rollout.

sam: Upgrade completed successfully after skipping migration. Canary passed.

lee: Follow-ups: 1) Chart change: migration job should not request GPUs and should tolerate label renames (use topology/affinity that isn't tied to nodepool label). 2) Add a compatibility shim for device-plugin resource names or read from a config value. 3) Lock terraform variable for node label key or add migration step and announce breaking change.

anika: Created GH issue redwood/inference-chart#3245 summarizing root cause and proposed changes. I'll attach the `kubectl` snippets and the CR finalizer note.

maria: Please also add a short blameless note to the release playbook and a line in the `helm upgrade` checklist to check hook jobs for nodeSelector/gpu requests.

sre-oncall: +1, adding `release-incidents` tag and raising a short postmortem item.

sam: Thanks everyone — resolved for now. Follow-ups tracked in #3245. :tada:
